theorems.name: Submission.lusin_closed_subset_continuousOn_volume
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [MeasurableSpace F] [BorelSpace F] (u : Rn n → F) (S : Set (Rn n)), Measurable u → MeasurableSet S → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ C ⊆ S, IsClosed C ∧ volume (S \ C) < ε ∧ ContinuousOn u C
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
